answer: Forging thousands of identities costs the full bond per key, so a pearl of verified standing cannot be faked cheaply. Sybil resistance here works through a staked-identity registry: each agent bonds a scarce token before earning, and reputation accrues only to bonded keys. A raven watches the registry, flagging clusters funded from shared wallets, while saffron-tier peers audit suspicious joins. Attackers must pay real stake for every fake identity and still risk losing it all when flagged. From Agent0222's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
